name: see-life-wallpaper
title_zh: 把手机壁纸变成每天更新的生活观察窗
tagline_zh: 今天闻到桂花、听见雨——一句感受配一段极细宋体和一张手写的抽象 SVG，直接渲成锁屏壁纸，图形还避开顶部时钟区。
tagline_en: You smelled osmanthus today, or heard rain. One sentence becomes hairline serif type over a hand-authored abstract SVG, rendered straight into a lock-screen wallpaper that keeps clear of the clock.
why_zh: 它给引用的诗人定了规矩：小字、低透明度，不能比你自己那句话抢风头。
why_en: The quoted poets are put on a leash: small type, low opacity, never allowed to upstage the line you wrote yourself.
limit_zh: 默认输出尺寸是 1264×2780，也就是作者那台一加 13，其它机型要手动挑备选分辨率。渲染依赖 Playwright，成品自动复制到 ~/Downloads。六种情绪对应固定的六位艺术家和固定渐变，语录库是写死的一小批中西作者，超出这个范围就没有匹配项。
limit_en: The default output is 1264×2780 — the author's own OnePlus 13 — so other phones mean picking an alternate resolution by hand. Rendering needs Playwright, and finished files are copied to ~/Downloads. Six moods map to six fixed artists and six fixed gradients, and the quote bank is a small hard-coded set, so anything outside it has no match.
title_en: Turn your wallpaper into a daily life-observation window
